changelog: A DAILY COMMISSION IS ONE ATTEMPT, RESUMED RATHER THAN RESTARTED. Abandoning a Commission and opening it again used to start it over — the seed is fixed, so you could walk away from a bad opening as often as you liked and finish only the attempt that suited you. The Commission now keeps a save of its own: leave it for an ordinary campaign and come back to it exactly where it stood, with neither run able to destroy the other. One left over from a previous day is dropped rather than resumed into — its seed and its leaderboard have both closed — and a finished Commission cannot be started again.
